doc_title_en: Notice regarding change in major shareholders and acquisition of NEXON shares (share purchase constituting a regulated block acquisition under Financial Instruments and Exchange Act Ordinance Article 30)
doc_title_jp: 主要株主の異動及び当社株式（証券コード 3659）の取得（公開買付けに準ずる行為として政令で定める買集め行為）に関するお知らせ
summary_en: NXC Corporation acquired 118,527,140 shares held by subsidiary NXMH B.V. through share purchase (not tender offer). NXC's voting share increased from 31.40% to 46.38%; NXMH's stake reduced from 14.99% to 0.01%, moving it off major shareholder list. Transaction qualifies as regulated block acquisition under Financial Instruments and Exchange Act Ordinance Article 30 §1 ¶4. No impact on management or results anticipated.
summary_jp: NXC傘下のNXMH B.V.が保有する株式118,527,140株をNXCが取得。NXCの議決権比率31.40%→46.38%、NXMHの議決権14.99%→0.01%に低下。金融商品取引法施行令30条第1項第4号に基づく買集め行為。経営・業績への影響なし。
